repos_data.description: MCP server for controlling Adobe After Effects from AI clients (Claude, etc.) - ExtendScript execution, background rendering, deep project/layer inspection, and first-class Arabic/RTL & multilingual support. 47 tools.
The MCP server for Adobe Edge Delivery Services — 41 tools. An AI agent can read, audit, track, monitor, fix (a page or the whole site), publish, and undo — all safely and reversibly.
